messages:
maria: Heads-up I'm opening a micro-PR to update the 'hello-dock' quickstart: clarify auth (env vs inline), swap Dockerfile to multi-stage, add GH Actions secret one-liner, and a tiny troubleshooting note for macOS networking. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4789

tom: Sounds good. Can you paste the Dockerfile change in this thread for a quick sanity check?

maria: Pasted minimal version in PR and below:

```dockerfile
FROM python:3.11-slim AS builder
WORKDIR /build
COPY pyproject.toml requirements.txt ./
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt -t /build/.deps

FROM python:3.11-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=builder /build/.deps /app/.deps
COPY --chown=1000:1000 . /app
ENV PYTHONPATH=/app/.deps:/app
CMD ["python", "app.py"]
```

kelly: LGTM. Please also add `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=...` example and a .env snippet so folks don't paste tokens into examples.

maria: Added both and a short GH Actions line: `echo \"$REDWOOD_API_KEY\" | gh secret set REDWOOD_API_KEY` + a 3-line workflow example in the PR.

doc-bot: Link-check run: replaced broken internal reference to auth guide. No secrets detected in diffs.

tom: Quick review done, left two tiny wording nits. Nothing blocking.

maria: Thanks 680 will address and merge after CI passes. Ping here for follow-ups.
